candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Load the candidate demo build — zero public canary traffic. The replay path calls no authenticated route and persists nothing beyond sessionStorage
candidateVerificationJourney.notes: Issue's own Release evidence section, transcribed verbatim. Card consumption was a side effect of the mock ExecutionRecord deleted by #1320 part 2; this restores the rendered outcome ADR-084 decision 6 requires, on a surface that persists nothing.

journeys.name: confirmed-run-leaves-recommendations-and-appears-in-ledger
assertions: Dùng thử Demo → approve → confirm → return to Decisions
the recommendation is absent from Đề xuất
the run is present in Đang thực hiện's finished section with its real terminal state
the browser issues no /v1/* request throughout

journeys.name: declined-run-renders-as-a-choice
assertions: declining removes the recommendation from Đề xuất the same way
the ledger renders the declined outcome as a choice, never as an error

journeys.name: manual-refresh-restores-the-recommendation
assertions: Làm mới Demo returns the recommendation to Đề xuất
Làm mới Demo empties the replay run from Đang thực hiện
this is what makes #1322's two walks (confirm once, decline once) possible

journeys.name: signed-in-ledger-unshadowed
assertions: with a token present, Đang thực hiện still populates from GET /v1/demo/runs
seeded replay content does not shadow or suppress real runs

staticAssetChecks.notes: No new assets. The captured scenario must still be present in the built artifact — verify-replay-scenario-in-build.mjs stays wired and passing.

migrationCompatibility.notes: Issue text: 'No migration.' Client-side sessionStorage state and a seeded ledger source in apps/demo.

rollbackAssertion.notes: Issue text: a rollback returns to showing the recommendation after completion rather than leaving the ledger seeded with a run that has no decision behind it.

doNotInfer: release evidence fields beyond what the issue's Release evidence (ADR-035) section states
using localStorage — a decision surviving a tab close leaves the next visitor with the recommendation already missing, which is worse than the behaviour being fixed
copying the run into storage; store only the decision, and derive every WorkflowRunListItem field from the captured scenario so there is one source of truth
building a replay-only ledger beside groupRunsIntoLedgerSections() — same grouping, different source, or the two drift
letting seeded replay content shadow real runs on the signed-in path
rendering a declined run as an error or a failure exit
issuing any /v1/* request from the replay path to make the ledger populate
editing the other ten workflows' Decisions or In-Progress tests to accommodate this
